judgment: It is good to hold firm.
image: So the noble one strengthens himself,
lines: The dragon appears in the field.
It is good to see the great person.
All day the noble one is strong, and strong again;
at dusk still wary, as if in danger.
Perhaps leaping, still in the deep.
It is good to see the great person.
special: Dragons appear together, no head among them.

notes.name_en: 乾 is the doubled heaven trigram; title names the thing (heaven), rejecting Wilhelm's 'The Creative'.
notes.judgment: 元亨利貞 in the fixed two-sentence form settled after the pilot review.
notes.L1: 潛龍 in the glossary form 'The dragon lies hidden.' ('in the deep' rejected: no word for the deep); standalone 勿用 'Do not act.' (no 'not yet the time').
notes.L6: 亢龍: 亢 is overreaching, arrogant height; 'flies too high' keeps L5's flight and the excess.
notes.special: 見群龍無首: 見 reads 'appear'; 首 kept as 'head', animal and leader at once.
notes.L3: 若厲無咎: 厲 stays inside 若, 'as if in danger'; no second, actual 'there is danger'.
notes.L4: 或躍在淵: the leaping one is still in the deep; B keeps the place with the leap.
